provenance.scope: the wing's opening card, words by key
provenance.rule: Stand-ins until the wave 4 words round writes them. The line keeps the facts sheet's limits: earliest DATED drawing, never 'first'; the country near Vinci where he grew up, never a named viewpoint or his birthplace.
provenance.start_word: the owner's own words from the walk (FINDINGS item 23)

line.en: His earliest dated drawing, 5 August 1473: the Arno valley country near Vinci, where he grew up.
line.de: Seine früheste datierte Zeichnung, 5. August 1473: die Landschaft am Arno bei Vinci, wo er aufwuchs.
line.certainty_note: The date and 'earliest dated' are documented by the holder; 'near Vinci, where he grew up' is likely when said loosely; the exact viewpoint is disputed and is not named.
